The '''Primary Rights-Holders Complex''' was a [[pressure]] located in the [[o'beki]] of [[A'Lenba]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Due to the smaller nature of the o'beki, the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] shared a single complex. One thousand beings worked in the facility, and no native [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] were allowed to enter. Security was provided by Karflo personnel.
